description: Keeps roke's dependencies up to date: images, tools and actions. Every update is a pull request to review by hand; nothing is merged automatically. Projects keep the service versions they pinned, so updating a default only affects new projects until `roke service upgrade`.

customManagers.description: Service images in compose files: image: name:${X_VERSION:-tag}
Service images whose name is a setting too: image: ${X_IMAGE:-name}:${X_VERSION:-tag}
Versions annotated with a renovate comment, such as the Dockerfile's ARGs
Local MCP servers' Python packages in catalog/mcps/*/mcp.json: uvx package==version
Local MCP servers' npm packages in catalog/mcps/*/mcp.json: npx package@version

packageRules.description: Tools and actions: one pull request a week for minor and patch updates
Major versions of service images: projects keep theirs, but a new major may change a data format, so flag them
prBodyNotes: A major version: projects keep the one they pinned until `roke service upgrade NAME --major`. Check the service's README and release notes for changes to its data format, and update the README if migration steps are needed.

packageRules.description: kwok's tags carry the Kubernetes version they simulate: v0.8.0-k8s.v1.36.1
